financing: The site lists Cherry, Alphaeon Credit, Affirm and United Medical Credit, says financed procedures must be paid in full 10 days before surgery, and that a booking fee locks the price for 12 months.
notes: Mia Aesthetics is a multi-city chain (14 locations); the Miami clinic page (9300 SW 72nd St) publishes no prices of its own. All recorded prices are the chain-wide 'Starting Price' shown at the top of each national procedure page with the footnote '*Pricing Varies by Surgeon'; none is tied to a city, so the Miami price could differ and is not separately published. Pages do not say what the starting price includes. Facelift and neck lift both show $12,900. NOT RECORDED: the Lipo 360 page shows no price (the separate Liposuction page shows 'Starting Price: $4,000*', which is not Lipo 360). RF Microneedling ('Starting at $1,000') is on a page titled for Atlanta and J-Plasma skin tightening ('Pricing as Low as $1,700') is not one of the requested procedures; neither was recorded for Miami. No abdominal-etching, botox/filler or laser-resurfacing prices found. The financing page mentions specials and reduced prices for new doctors but gives no figures. No Google rating or review count appears on the pages fetched. /pricing/ returns 404; there is no price-list or specials page.
